confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from unauthorized off-hours access to privilege escalation, cross-departmental data theft, and anti-forensic measures (log deletion). The sequence of events is highly consistent with a compromised account or malicious insider.

attack_chain.description: Unauthorized off-hours access and download of sensitive finance files (payroll.xlsx) from an external IP (185.220.101.34).
Continued download of sensitive finance files (contracts.xlsx).
Successful self-escalation of privileges from 'read_only' to 'admin'.
Unauthorized access to the HR department directory, which is outside the user's normal scope.
Exfiltration of sensitive HR data (salary_bands.xlsx) following privilege escalation.
Execution of anti-forensic measures by deleting the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log).
Data exfiltration of approximately 10MB of data to the external IP (185.220.101.34).

gaps: Verification of whether user_04's credentials were stolen via phishing or if this was a direct insider threat.
Confirmation of the identity of the owner of IP 185.220.101.34.
narrative: User_04, a junior accountant, accessed the system during off-hours from an external IP to download sensitive finance files. The actor then escalated their privileges to admin, accessed the HR department's directory to download salary information, deleted authentication logs to hide their tracks, and exfiltrated data to an external address.
